The '''Nyemari system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Atlas Companion" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyemari]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Nyemarian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] as well as the sector's most modern, architecturally sophisticated [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]].<ref name="Uprising" />
